mapper.sql: student.id AS student_id, student.student_name, enrollment_organization.id AS organization_id, enrollment_organization.organization_name, parent_user.id AS parent_user_id, parent_user.display_name AS parent_display_name, parent_user.mobile, parent_student.relation_role AS relationship_role

FROM edu_student student JOIN edu_student_organization enrollment ON enrollment.student_id = student.id AND enrollment.relation_type = 'ENROLLMENT' AND enrollment.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN sys_organization enrollment_organization ON enrollment_organization.id = enrollment.organization_id AND enrollment_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND enrollment_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' JOIN sys_organization_admin organization_admin ON organization_admin.user_id = #{operatorUserId} JOIN sys_organization managed_organization ON managed_organization.id = organization_admin.organization_id AND managed_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND managed_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' JOIN edu_parent_student parent_student ON parent_student.student_id = student.id AND parent_student.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN sys_user parent_user ON parent_user.id = parent_student.parent_user_id AND parent_user.user_type = 'FAMILY' AND parent_user.status = 'ENABLED' AND parent_user.mobile IS NOT NULL JOIN sys_user_role parent_user_role ON parent_user_role.user_id = parent_user.id JOIN sys_role parent_role ON parent_role.id = parent_user_role.role_id AND parent_role.role_code = 'PARENT' AND parent_role.status = 'ENABLED' WHERE student.status = 'ENABLED' AND enrollment_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(managed_organization.organization_path, '%')

SELECT DISTINCT enrollment_organization.id FROM edu_student student JOIN edu_student_organization enrollment ON enrollment.student_id = student.id AND enrollment.relation_type = 'ENROLLMENT' AND enrollment.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN sys_organization enrollment_organization ON enrollment_organization.id = enrollment.organization_id AND enrollment_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND enrollment_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' JOIN sys_organization_admin organization_admin ON organization_admin.user_id = #{operatorUserId} JOIN sys_organization managed_organization ON managed_organization.id = organization_admin.organization_id AND managed_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND managed_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE student.id = #{studentId} AND student.status = 'ENABLED' AND enrollment_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(managed_organization.organization_path, '%') ORDER BY enrollment_organization.id LIMIT 1
